name: Frozen Frontier
description: Follow the lost Northwatch expedition across a wind-scoured frontier, through an empty settlement and blue ice caves, to a buried observatory beneath the glacier. Find the missing route markers, recover supplies from abandoned camps, and face the ancient guardian awakened under the ice.

items.name: Ice Axe
items.description: A steel climbing axe with a sturdy spike, useful when a route turns hostile.

items.name: Expedition Sabre
items.description: A short sabre kept sharp inside an oiled sheath.

items.name: Frostbound Staff
items.description: A pale staff carved with the same stars as the buried observatory.

items.name: Hide Buckler
items.description: A small wooden shield covered in thick cured hide.

items.name: Fur Hood
items.description: A weathered hood lined with white winter fur.

items.name: Padded Parka
items.description: A heavy expedition coat reinforced at the shoulders.

items.name: Warming Broth
items.description: A sealed flask of spiced broth, still safe to drink.

properties.use_message: The broth warms your hands and steadies your breathing. (The expedition's standard recovery rules apply.)

items.name: Field Dressing
items.description: Clean bandages and salve packed in waxed cloth.

properties.use_message: You bind your wounds and take a moment to recover. (The expedition's standard recovery rules apply.)

items.name: Storm Lantern
items.description: A shuttered lantern with enough oil to light a stretch of ice cave.

properties.use_message: The lantern throws amber light through the blue ice.

items.name: Northwatch Key
items.description: A brass key stamped with the crest of the deserted watch station.

items.name: Star Seal
items.description: A stone seal cut to fit the observatory's inner door.

items.name: Expedition Journal
items.description: A water-stained log that charts a route from Northwatch to the glacier.

items.name: Etched Compass
items.description: A brass compass whose lid bears an unfamiliar constellation.

items.name: Northwatch Locker
items.description: A locked supply locker dragged clear of a collapsed wall.

items.name: Glacial Reliquary
items.description: A sealed stone case from the observatory, rimmed with blue ice.

npcs.name: Stranded Cartographer
npcs.description: A frostbitten mapmaker huddled beside a sheltered fire, guarding a bundle of route sketches.

nodes.body: 'Northwatch emptied when the ice began to move. We followed the old survey stakes into a blue cave, but something was walking below us.'

responses.text: How do I reach the buried observatory?

nodes.body: 'Keep the carved stars on your right. The watch captain carried the locker key, and the guardian below holds the seal for the inner door.'

npcs.name: Northwatch Keeper
npcs.description: The last keeper of the frozen settlement, wrapped in blankets inside a boarded-up storehouse.

nodes.body: 'The other explorers took our stores and headed for the glacier. Check the old signal tower for the captain's journal, but stay off the lake ice near the shore.'

responses.text: Thank you. I will watch the lake.

enemies.name: Snow Wolf
enemies.description: A lean white wolf stalking the trail from behind a drift.

enemies.name: Ice Cave Stalker
enemies.description: A pale predator that waits in the blue crevasses for warmth and movement.

enemies.name: Rogue Explorer
enemies.description: A desperate member of the lost expedition who now raids every camp along the route.

enemies.name: Yeti
enemies.description: A towering shaggy hunter that follows the mountain passes above the ice caves.

enemies.name: Ice Elemental
enemies.description: A figure of fractured glacier ice, animated by light from the buried observatory.

enemies.name: Glacier Warden
enemies.description: An ancient armored sentinel entombed with the observatory, now risen beneath a crown of ice.

descriptions.text: Half-buried survey stakes lead away from the last sheltered pass. A Northwatch sign points across a white plain toward the glacier.
The narrow pass opens below the storm line. Old sled tracks wind toward safer ground between wind-bent pines.
Snow has filled the stairs to a stone cellar. A locked expedition locker rests beyond scattered crates and a collapsed shelf.
A domed hall lies beneath the glacier. Constellations cut into the floor shine under clear ice, and an armored warden stands before the sealed inner door.
Drifts erase the trail between a line of dark rocks. Only the tops of survey stakes remain above the snow.
A narrow ridge crosses open ground. Wind combs loose snow from its edge and exposes old boot prints underneath.
Two canvas tents sag beneath ice. A dead fire and a cooking pot mark where the expedition left in haste.
Boarded houses flank a street buried to its windowsills. A bell hangs silent over the settlement storehouse.
The upper platform has fallen into the snow. Beneath its broken signal brazier, a dry compartment holds scraps of an expedition log.
Clouded ice stretches between steep banks. Dark seams and trapped air bubbles reveal where the crossing is weakest.
Smooth walls glow blue around a winding passage. Fresh claw marks cut across older chisel marks beside the floor.
A natural ice span crosses a deep crack. Frayed expedition rope still hangs from an anchor on the far side.
Ancient pillars show through the ice on both sides of this long chamber. Their carved stars point deeper beneath the glacier.
Stone roofs protrude from packed snow around a small square. A frozen well stands beneath an arch older than Northwatch.
Shelves of carved tablets stand behind clear ice. A narrow aisle leads toward the observatory's sealed chambers.
Wind drives loose snow across the ground, hiding tracks within minutes.
A wolf howl carries over the ridge, followed by an answer farther away.
The ice creaks under slow pressure somewhere out of sight.
Broken sled fittings and frozen rope show where the expedition struggled onward.
Blue light passes through the glacier, revealing old stone beneath it.
Carved constellations appear on exposed pillars, all pointing toward the inner hall.

config.objective: Defeat the glacier warden and recover the star seal.

config.secret: Search beneath the collapsed shelf for the expedition locker.

config.hazard: Thin ice covers a narrow crack in the cave floor.

config.secret: Search the lee side of a buried survey marker.
